result.rationale: The diff in office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts removes the console.error that logged tokenResponse.error (zodError) and the MS response body, replacing it with parseRefreshTokenResponse, which only throws the generic 'Invalid refreshed tokens were returned'. This is factually accurate and observability-relevant: the specific zod error details and raw Microsoft response were the only diagnostics for refresh failures and are now lost, hampering debugging. It is not a correctness defect itself, so it fits important_non_bug.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous `console.error("Outlook error grabbing new tokens...", tokenResponse.error, "MS response:", responseJson)` block was removed when switching from `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper throws a generic `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on schema failure and does not log the zod error or the MS response, so the detailed diagnostic information is indeed lost in this diff. This is an observability/debuggability regression rather than a functional defect by itself.
